name: Slayer Spell Sever
body:
Sometimes, a certain set of skills are needed to deal with dangerous spell-users or magic items. The spell sever is the person to hire.

Spell Hunter (Ex)

If the spell sever deals damage to a creature that casts spells or has spell-like abilities, as an immediate action they can apply their studied target bonus against that target even if he didn’t sneak attack it.

This ability replaces track.

Sense Aura (Sp)

At 2nd level, the spell sever can use detect magic at will as a standard action. At 10th level, this becomes the spell arcane sight. These spells use the spell sever’s class level as their caster level.

This replaces the slayer talent gained at 2nd level.

Disrupting Presence (Ex)

At 7th level, the spell sever can make intonations and movements that distract a spellcaster’s spell components. They apply their studied target bonus as a penalty to all concentration checks made by their target.

This ability replaces stalker.

See Through Tricks (Ex)

At 11th level, the spell sever gains a bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting and illusions spells equal to 1/4 their spell sever class level.

This ability replaces swift tracker.

Spell-Thwart (Su)

At 13th level, the spell sever can shed a magical effect placed upon them once per day. This operates as the spell break enchantment using the spell sever’s class level for the caster level. At 17th level, The spell sever can use this ability twice per day.

This ability replaces slayer’s advance.
